newsitem.title: SPAIN: Bonos end up, pulled higher by foreign markets.
newsitem.headline: Bonos end up, pulled higher by foreign markets.

text.p: 1515 GMT - Bonos end higher with the long bond future at a fresh record high. 10-year spread over Bunds fell to 67 vs 68 * 10-yr 7.35 pct T-bond 107.68 vs 107.25, yield 6.26 vs 6.32 * Sept bond future 117.40 vs 117.02 at yesterday's close * Peseta/mark 84.43/44 vs 84.43/46
